notes: The prism itself is fine: a whole hexagonal prism at rest, 47 x 65vmin with the zone, centred; the slider rebuilds it (12 sides shown) with panels growing from the axis, and it reads on both stages. The problem is the slider inside the shared pill: its thumb and track are the browser's own, in px, so they do not scale with the canvas. On a 360 x 300 card the thumb is about 5vmin and the track short and thick; at full screen the thumb is under 2vmin and the track a hairline inside a 72px pill; on the light stage the unfilled track is the browser's near-black. So the control looks different on every canvas size and export, which the control block exists to prevent. Style the range (thumb and track, e.g. ::-webkit-slider-thumb / ::-moz-range-thumb and the track) in vmin, with the track in the block's tint, so it is the same share of every canvas and reads on both stages.
